source.quote: With regards to our consolidated vehicle sales, we have increased our forecasts from the time of our first quarter results by 300,000 units to 7.5 million units.
As for Toyota and Lexus brand vehicle sales, we anticipate that vehicle sales will be at 8.9 million units, a 300,000 unit increase from our forecast that was announced in November 2020.
Consolidated vehicle sales for the fiscal year ending March 2022 are expected to be 8.7 million units, which is 113.8% of such sales of the previous fiscal year.
